ops.title: Fold dashboard-fold-2b into main: steps and the 15 conflict files
ops.body:
Steps to fold yasyf/cc-skills `dashboard-fold-2b` into `main`. meta-desk chose this order in record 456766: no fold tonight, and the fold lane starts once the line is quiet.

## State at 97f0678 (line tip) against main f1907b2

- The fork point is 0a8a13a (Oct 27). The line has 242 commits main lacks: 139 on `dashboard-fold-2` and 103 more on `dashboard-fold-2b`. Main has 4007 commits the line lacks.
- `dashboard-pages-needs` exists on no remote. It lives only in the gt metadata of lane clones.
- 95 merged PRs were based on the line. Open ones at the time of the read: #3150, #3139, #2962, #2822.
- Main has 16 dashboard commits since the fork whose titles appear nowhere on the line: #2665, #2474, #2392, #2202, #2001, #1940, #1584, #1545, #1239, #1206, #1208, #1073, #1024, #1022, #883, #879. The line has its own `own_names` but lacks main's model-key code from #2392.
- The owner picked fold-2b on Oct 29, through board card dashboard-fold-2. The Mac's `inbox/stack.json` reads `{"prs": []}`.

## Conflicts from `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main origin/dashboard-fold-2b` (15 files)

1. plugins/design-doc/skills/design-doc/templates/design-doc.html
2. plugins/incident-retro/skills/incident-retro/templates/incident-retro.html
3. plugins/long-running/dashboard/app/app.css
4. plugins/long-running/dashboard/app/app.js
5. plugins/long-running/dashboard/app/review.js
6. plugins/long-running/dashboard/app/review_assistant.py
7. plugins/long-running/dashboard/app/server.py
8. plugins/long-running/pyproject.toml
9. plugins/long-running/skills/long-running/SKILL.md
10. plugins/long-running/skills/long-running/reference/dashboard-keeper-brief.md (main deleted it and the line modified it)
11. plugins/long-running/skills/long-running/reference/drive-dashboard.md
12. plugins/long-running/skills/long-running/templates/drive-assist.html
13. plugins/long-running/skills/long-running/templates/src/drive-assist.html
14. plugins/long-running/tests/test_drive_dashboard.py
15. plugins/long-running/uv.lock

## Steps

1. Freeze the line. Every open PR based on it lands or parks, and nothing new merges into it.
2. Cut one branch from a freshly fetched `main` and merge `origin/dashboard-fold-2b` into it.
3. Make `plugins/long-running/dashboard` take the line's tree byte for byte: `git checkout origin/dashboard-fold-2b -- plugins/long-running/dashboard`. Then check that `git rev-parse HEAD:plugins/long-running/dashboard` equals the tree in `<state dir>/dashboard.served`. With equal trees, `lr dashboard restart` sees no change, and nothing new reaches the owner without his yes.
4. Resolve the other 10 conflicts outside the dashboard directory by hand. For dashboard-keeper-brief.md, either keep main's delete or keep the line's file. That is a pick for meta-desk.
5. Open the PR with a real body and let CI grade it. The merged `test_drive_dashboard.py` is the likeliest red, since main's version meets the line's version, which adds 1843 lines.
6. Merge, then retarget each open line PR with `gh pr edit <n> --base main -R yasyf/cc-skills` and restack it.
7. Delete `dashboard-fold-2` and `dashboard-fold-2b` on origin, and drop `dashboard-pages-needs` from the lane clones. Update the brief rule that says a dashboard change bases on `origin/dashboard-fold-2b`, a skill update for meta-desk.
8. Open a separate PR that ports main's 16 dashboard fixes onto the folded tree, #2392 first. It changes what the owner sees, so it needs his yes on a card with a screenshot.

## Readers of main's dashboard directory

These move when the fold lands:

- The plugin release. Main autobumps long-running, so the installed plugin carries main's dashboard. After the fold it carries the line's.
- lr `internal/dashboard/proof.go`, and the tree check in `lr dashboard restart`.
- capt-hook `dashboard_live_needs_his_yes.py`, which keys on the path.
- `.github/workflows/live-dashboard-ci.yml`, which triggers on the path.
- pyproject's pythonpath entry `dashboard/app`.
- `lr/internal/prrow/guard_test.go`.
- communicator-brief.md and drive-dashboard.md, which point at `keep.py`.
